verdict.rationale: Checkout.com runs a card-issuing program, so this story applies. However, the evidence covers only spending limits, spend controls, wallet provisioning and SCA exemption support for acceptance. Nothing documents API-driven PIN set or reset flows, or 3DS enrollment of issued cards for online use.

support.subject: As a developer, cardholder credentials are manageable through the API — PIN set and reset flows, 3DS enrollment for online use where the region requires it — without support tickets
